title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-routing-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Ayesha Patel
description: Motivation: Dedicated fleets occasionally suffer from priority inversion during bursts where low-priority workloads consume available burst tokens and cause SLO violations for high-priority customers. This PR implements two coordinated changes: 1) priority-aware routing for the dedicated autoscaler so burst capacity is reserved and routed preferentially to higher-priority routes during overloaded periods, and 2) improved utilization and burst reporting (per-priority time-series and summaries) so operators can monitor token consumption, headroom, and burst reclaim events. Summary of changes: adds priority weights and token buckets to the fleet autoscaler, updates the routing decision path to consult priority queues before allocating burst tokens, exposes new metrics (dedicated.autoscaler.burst_tokens_consumed{priority}, dedicated.autoscaler.burst_headroom_pct{priority}, dedicated.autoscaler.reclaimed_burst_events), instruments rollout canary for the new policy, adds end-to-end tests covering priority routing during sustained bursts, and updates docs and alerting playbooks. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (Linear ENG-4021) reviewed - [x] Unit + e2e tests added - [x] Metrics and dashboards updated - [x] Canary rollout configuration included - [x] Backwards-compatible by default (new policy opt-in via fleet config) How it works: the autoscaler maintains per-priority token buckets sized based on committed throughput and historical burst patterns. When a burst is requested the router first checks high-priority buckets and routes requests accordingly; if unavailable it gracefully falls back to shared burst pool or lower-priority buckets depending on policy. Operators can configure per-fleet priority weights and minimum guaranteed throughput. Rollout: feature gated behind fleet config flag 'priority_routing_v1' and enabled for a single canary fleet in prod for 24h before global rollout. Related: builds on earlier tokenbucket smoothing work (PRs in this area: see recent autoscaler/burst reports).

release_notes: Enhanced dedicated autoscaler with priority-aware routing and burst reporting. Adds per-priority token buckets, new metrics for burst consumption and headroom, and a canary rollout. Backwards-compatible: feature gated via fleet config 'priority_routing_v1'.
notes: Canary monitored for 48h after merge; no SLO regressions observed. Dashboard pre-created under observability/dashboards and an alert tuned to fire on sustained headroom < 5% for high priority routes.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: misconfiguration could starve lower-priority customers during large bursts. Mitigation: default policy is opt-in; minimum guarantees are enforced and can be tuned per-fleet; alerts created for reclamation spikes.
testing_summary: Unit tests (coverage + edge cases for token underflow), integration tests against legacy tokenbucket compatibility, and an e2e simulating mixed-priority sustained burst scenario included. Perf bench shows <3% p95 latency impact when enabled.
documentation_changes: Updated docs/dedicated/autoscaler_priority_routing.md, added runbook entries and an example demo in examples/priority-routing-demo.
